items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: He's a big man. I ain't make plenty of money in the union. He's called Dave, yeah.

ctx.x: I mean, the fella I told you, he used to come out so often, but I don't sense. He needed to cut him out. And you don't care what's coming out. He's a big man. I ain't make plenty of money in the union. He's called Dave, yeah.
Dave Bartholomew, but I mean in the old days. Oh, the old days. Oh, yeah.
